title: Dances and food at the clubs
summary: Barnes describes who danced and the food and drink served at the dances where the bands played.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well who would the men dance with? I don't get that. Who would the men dance with?
Oh, a kid that's joking, has music man, and drinking beer.

Stag. It wasn't stag dance. Winners, winners, and maybe a little gravy and macaroni, or have somebody to cook the dinner, have somebody to cook for them. Maybe chicken and macaroni, you know, and winners, and beer. And as well as the beer and cags, you see, and whiskey and wine and all that. Well some of them would want it, they'd get a shot at it, you know. Different places, they'd be there in most different clubs to play. See that place, Lucian Tenor, out here on Dolphin and Legion Field? We met, we were playing there for years. We was playing in there when we was with Buddy for tea, you see, what you call the bars in blue. Like Houston, St. Louis Armstrong, right there in the very same building, you see now, in downtown Riverside, the bank, and there's three people staying there now. Lusitania home? Lucian Tenor. Right across in the square.
